claims: Chuck Norris identified as a Southern Baptist.
Chuck Norris was a long-time member of Prestonwood Baptist Church in Dallas, Texas.
Chuck Norris grew up in a Christian home.
Chuck Norris was baptized at age 12.
Chuck Norris credited his mother, Wilma Norris Knight, for instilling spiritual values in him from a young age.
Chuck Norris admitted to drifting away from God during his early years in Hollywood.
Chuck Norris rededicated his life to Christ as a young adult at a Billy Graham Crusade.
Chuck Norris's faith was activated during a medical crisis involving his wife Gena’s pregnancy with twins.
In his later years, Chuck Norris and his wife read the Bible together daily.
Chuck Norris and his wife were vocal advocates for bringing Bible curriculum back to public schools.
Chuck Norris and his wife endorsed programs that taught the Bible as elective history and literature.
Chuck Norris integrated his faith into his KICKSTART Program youth outreach.
Chuck Norris appeared on the Trinity Broadcasting Network (TBN).
Chuck Norris worked with the Billy Graham Association.
Chuck Norris was 86 years old when he died.
